015import javax.swing.*;

017import java.awt.*;
018import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
019import java.io.File;

029/**
030 * A lightweight GUI-based TIFF stack movie player built on ImageJ and Swing.
031 * <p>
032 * Loads a TIFF file, extracts frame timing, and provides a movie player with:
033 * play/pause, playback speed control, and frame navigation. Rendering is
034 * performed on Swing components, while TIFF handling is delegated to ImageJ.
035 * </p>
036 */
037public class TiffMoviePlayer {
038
039    /**
040     * Loads and plays a multi-frame TIFF stack in a dedicated Swing window.
041     *
042     * @param tiffPath absolute or relative path to the TIFF file
043     */
044    public void playMovie(String tiffPath) {
045        playMovie(tiffPath, null);
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * Loads and plays a multi-frame TIFF stack in a dedicated Swing window, notifying the
050     * caller when playback has finished.
051     * <p>
052     * This method returns immediately: the TIFF is loaded on a background thread and the
053     * player window is built afterwards on the EDT. {@code onFinished} is therefore the only
054     * reliable way for a caller to know when the player is gone.
055     * </p>
056     * <p>
057     * {@code onFinished} is invoked exactly once, on the EDT, whichever way playback ends:
058     * when the user closes the player window, or immediately if the TIFF cannot be loaded.
059     * Callers that disable UI while a movie plays can rely on it always being called back,
060     * and so on never being left permanently disabled.
061     * </p>
062     *
063     * @param tiffPath   absolute or relative path to the TIFF file
064     * @param onFinished run on the EDT when the player window closes or loading fails;
065     *                   may be {@code null}
066     */
067    public void playMovie(String tiffPath, Runnable onFinished) {
068
069        // Guarantee "exactly once", however playback ends.
070        final AtomicBoolean finishedFired = new AtomicBoolean(false);
071        final Runnable finish = () -> {
072            if (onFinished != null && finishedFired.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
073                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(onFinished);
074            }
075        };
076
077        final String fileName = new File(tiffPath).getName();
078
079        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
080        // LOADING DIALOG (lightweight splash while ImageJ loads the TIFF)
081        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
082        final JDialog loadingDialog = new JDialog((Frame) null, "Loading Recording", false);
083        loadingDialog.setDefaultCloseOperation(JDialog.DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE);
084        loadingDialog.setLayout(new BorderLayout());
085
086        JLabel label = new JLabel("Loading " + fileName + "…", SwingConstants.CENTER);
087        label.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.PLAIN, 13));
088        label.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(25, 20, 25, 20));
089        loadingDialog.add(label, BorderLayout.CENTER);
090
091        loadingDialog.setSize(300, 120);
092        loadingDialog.setResizable(false);
093        loadingDialog.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
094
095        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> loadingDialog.setVisible(true));
096
097        // ==========================================================================
098        // BACKGROUND THREAD: load TIFF, apply contrast enhancement, open UI window
099        // ==========================================================================
100        new Thread(() -> {
101
102            ImagePlus   imp           = null;
103            String      failureDetail = null;
104            PrintStream originalOut   = System.out;
105
106            try {
107                System.setProperty("apple.awt.UIElement", "true");
108                IJ.redirectErrorMessages();
109                IJ.showStatus("");
110
111                // Silence ImageJ's console
112                System.setOut(new PrintStream(new OutputStream() {
113                    @Override
114                    public void write(int b) { /* ignore console output */ }
115                }));
116
117                // ImageJ reads TIFF. It cannot read ND2, and returns null rather than throwing,
118                // in which case Bio-Formats gets a go.
119                imp = IJ.openImage(tiffPath);
120
121                if (imp == null) {
122                    try {
123                        ImporterOptions opts = new ImporterOptions();
124                        opts.setId(tiffPath);
125                        opts.setAutoscale(true);
126                        opts.setStackOrder(ImporterOptions.ORDER_XYCZT);
127
128                        ImagePlus[] imps = BF.openImagePlus(opts);
129                        if (imps != null && imps.length > 0) {
130                            imp = imps[0];
131                        } else {
132                            failureDetail = "Bio-Formats opened the file but returned no images.";
133                            PaintLogger.errorf("Bio-Formats returned no images for %s", tiffPath);
134                        }
135                    } catch (Exception bfErr) {
136                        failureDetail = bfErr.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + bfErr.getMessage();
137                        PaintLogger.error("Failed to open image with Bio-Formats: " + tiffPath, bfErr);
138                    }
139                }
140            } catch (Throwable t) {
141                // The loader used to have a finally but no catch. Anything thrown here (an
142                // ImageJ error, a missing native library) killed the thread silently: the
143                // loading dialog was never disposed and the caller was never notified, so the
144                // viewer stayed disabled for good.
145                failureDetail = t.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + t.getMessage();
146                PaintLogger.error("Failed to open image: " + tiffPath, t);
147            } finally {
148                // Always restore stdout, so the process's console output isn't left
149                // permanently silenced, and always take the loading dialog down.
150                System.setOut(originalOut);
151                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(loadingDialog::dispose);
152            }
153
154            if (imp == null) {
155                // Show why, not just that. The cause was previously logged and then hidden
156                // behind a dialog that named only the file.
157                final String detail = failureDetail;
158                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
159                        null,
160                        "Failed to open image file:\n" + tiffPath
161                                + (detail == null ? "" : "\n\n" + detail),
162                        "Error",
163                        JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE
164                ));
165                finish.run();   // no window will ever open: release the caller now
166                return;
167            }
168
169            try {
170                // Optional contrast enhancement
171                IJ.run(imp, "Enhance Contrast", "saturated=0.35");
172
173                // Determine playback speed using calibration metadata
174                int delay = 50; // fallback
175                Calibration cal = imp.getCalibration();
176                if (cal != null && cal.frameInterval > 0) {
177                    delay = (int) Math.round(cal.frameInterval * 1000);
178                }
179                final int baseDelayMs = delay;
180
181                // --------------------------------------------------------
182                // UI CONSTRUCTION — must occur on the EDT
183                // --------------------------------------------------------
184                final ImagePlus impFinal = imp;
185
186                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> buildAndRunMovieWindow(impFinal, fileName, baseDelayMs, finish));
187
188            } catch (Throwable t) {
189                PaintLogger.error("Could not start the movie player for " + tiffPath, t);
190                finish.run();   // no window opened: do not leave the viewer disabled
191            }
192
193        }, "TiffLoaderThread").start();
194    }
195
196    // =============================================================================================
197    // INTERNAL: Build movie UI window + player loop
198    // =============================================================================================
199    private void buildAndRunMovieWindow(ImagePlus imp, String fileName, int baseDelayMs, Runnable onFinished) {
200
201        final JFrame frame = new JFrame("Movie Player - " + fileName);
202        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE);
203        frame.setLayout(new BorderLayout());
204
205        // Tell the caller when this window is gone. The playback thread below stops on its own,
206        // because it loops on frame.isVisible().
207        frame.addWindowListener(new java.awt.event.WindowAdapter() {
208            @Override
209            public void windowClosed(java.awt.event.WindowEvent e) {
210                onFinished.run();
211            }
212        });
213
214        // ----- Image display area -----
215        final JLabel imageLabel = new JLabel("", SwingConstants.CENTER);
216        imageLabel.setOpaque(true);
217        imageLabel.setBackground(Color.DARK_GRAY);
218
219        JPanel imagePanel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
220        imagePanel.setBackground(Color.DARK_GRAY);
221        imagePanel.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(4, 4, 4, 4));
222        imagePanel.add(imageLabel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
223        frame.add(imagePanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
224
225        // ----- Movie metadata -----
226        final int totalFrames         = imp.getStackSize();
227        final JSlider frameSlider     = new JSlider(1, totalFrames, 1);
228        final JLabel frameLabel       = new JLabel("Frame: 1");
229        final JButton playPauseButton = new JButton("⏸ Pause");
230        final JSlider speedSlider     = new JSlider(50, 400, 100); // 0.5× – 4.0×
231        final JLabel speedLabel       = new JLabel("Speed: 1.0×");
232
233        // ----- Layout for controls -----
234        JPanel controls = new JPanel(new GridLayout(2, 1, 0, 3));
235        controls.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(6, 6, 6, 6));
236        controls.setBackground(new Color(245, 245, 245));
237
238        JPanel topRow = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.CENTER, 8, 0));
239        topRow.setBackground(controls.getBackground());
240        frameSlider.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(260, 25));
241        topRow.add(playPauseButton);
242        topRow.add(frameSlider);
243        topRow.add(frameLabel);
244
245        JPanel bottomRow = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.CENTER, 8, 0));
246        bottomRow.setBackground(controls.getBackground());
247        speedSlider.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(100, 25));
248        speedSlider.setMajorTickSpacing(50);
249        speedSlider.setPaintTicks(true);
250        bottomRow.add(speedLabel);
251        bottomRow.add(speedSlider);
252
253        controls.add(topRow);
254        controls.add(bottomRow);
255
256        // ----- Close button -----
257        JButton closeButton = new JButton("Close");
258        closeButton.addActionListener(e -> frame.dispose());
259
260        JPanel closePanel = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 8, 4));
261        closePanel.setBackground(controls.getBackground());
262        closePanel.add(closeButton);
263
264        JPanel bottomPanel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
265        bottomPanel.add(controls, BorderLayout.CENTER);
266        bottomPanel.add(closePanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
267
268        frame.add(bottomPanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
269
270        // ----- Initial layout -----
271        frame.setSize(
272                Math.min(imp.getWidth() + 40, 1000),
273                Math.min(imp.getHeight() + 180, 900)
274        );
275        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
276        frame.setVisible(true);
277
278        // =======================================================================================
279        // Player state + listeners
280        // =======================================================================================
281        final boolean[] playing = {true};
282        final int[] currentFrame = {1};
283
284        // Toggle play/pause
285        playPauseButton.addActionListener(e -> {
286            playing[0] = !playing[0];
287            playPauseButton.setText(playing[0] ? "⏸ Pause" : "▶️ Play");
288        });
289
290        // Playback speed label
291        speedSlider.addChangeListener(e -> {
292            double raw = speedSlider.getValue() / 100.0;
293            double speed = Math.round(raw * 2) / 2.0;  // step of 0.5×
294            speedLabel.setText(String.format("Speed: %.1fx", speed));
295        });
296
297        // Manual frame navigation (only when paused)
298        frameSlider.addChangeListener(e -> {
299            if (!frameSlider.getValueIsAdjusting() && !playing[0]) {
300                final int frameIndex = frameSlider.getValue();
301                ImageProcessor ip2 = imp.getStack().getProcessor(frameIndex);
302                final BufferedImage img2 = ip2.getBufferedImage();
303                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
304                    imageLabel.setIcon(new ImageIcon(img2));
305                    frameLabel.setText("Frame: " + frameIndex);
306                });
307                currentFrame[0] = frameIndex;
308            }
309        });
310
311        // Show frame 1 immediately
312        ImageProcessor ip0 = imp.getStack().getProcessor(1);
313        imageLabel.setIcon(new ImageIcon(ip0.getBufferedImage()));
314
315        // =======================================================================================
316        // MOVIE PLAYBACK THREAD
317        // =======================================================================================
318        new Thread(() -> {
319            while (frame.isVisible()) {
320
321                if (playing[0]) {
322                    int frameIdx = currentFrame[0];
323                    ImageProcessor ip = imp.getStack().getProcessor(frameIdx);
324                    final BufferedImage img = ip.getBufferedImage();
325
326                    SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
327                        imageLabel.setIcon(new ImageIcon(img));
328                        frameLabel.setText("Frame: " + frameIdx);
329                        frameSlider.setValue(frameIdx);
330                    });
331
332                    // Speed multiplier
333                    double raw = speedSlider.getValue() / 100.0;
334                    double speed = Math.round(raw * 2) / 2.0;
335                    if (speed <= 0.0) {
336                        speed = 0.5;
337                    }
338
339                    long sleepTime = (long) (baseDelayMs / speed);
340                    if (sleepTime < 5) {
341                        sleepTime = 5;
342                    }
343
344                    try {
345                        Thread.sleep(sleepTime);
346                    } catch (InterruptedException ignored) { }
347
348                    // Next frame
349                    currentFrame[0]++;
350                    if (currentFrame[0] > totalFrames) {
351                        currentFrame[0] = 1;
352                    }
353
354                } else {
355                    // Paused: reduce CPU usage
356                    try { Thread.sleep(100); }
357                    catch (InterruptedException ignored) { }
358                }
359            }
360        }, "TiffMoviePlaybackThread").start();
361    }
362
363    /**
364     * Manual test runner for local development.
365     */
366    public static void main(String[] args) {
367        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() ->
368                                           new TiffMoviePlayer().playMovie(
369                                                   "/Volumes/Extreme Pro/Omero/221012/221012-Exp-3-A4-3.tif"
370                                           ));
371    }
372}
